recovery_contract: Keep device connectivity observations, service reachability, data source/freshness, authenticated access and rider availability as separate states. An exception or cache hit alone does not prove offline.
Show cached/last-known/unverified context honestly, including partial datasets. Failure is not empty, counts unavailable are not zero, and refresh completion is not a universal live-state guarantee.
Freshness badges/times require real provenance with defined meaning. Local cache write time is not server sync time; do not fabricate age, countdown, current badge or conflict-free state.
Propagate snapshot source and pending-write metadata where appropriate; pending local writes must not be displayed as server-confirmed Saved/Synced. Source capability must be verified per provider.
Retry reads under the current owner/query and lifetime, preserving useful context and filters without duplicate loads. Drop stale replies as in C19; no old-account cached projection.
Read retry, mutation outcome check, same-logical-action retry and saved-stage resume have separate labels and prerequisites. No universal offline queue, autosync or blind replay.

An ambiguous mutation may already have committed. Preserve original owner/request/payload identity; reconcile actual state before new action. Known rejection and changed-state conflict have distinct recovery.
Supported resume depends on actual domain journals, stage, access, file and eligibility window. Locally retained data is not a remotely completed/paid/delivered/approved outcome.
Marketplace resumes only its owner-bound saved checkout stage; existing gateway reopen may be allowed. Seller stock has no evidenced universal durable replay journal.
Delivery cached work remains unverified; retained proof retries attach the photo only after file/window/assignment checks, never reconfirm delivery. Account-keyed local proof schema is not assumed.
Associate payout identity is retained by review-screen lifetime; admin pending identity is most-recent in-memory action. No safe across-restart resume claim without durable identity/status recovery.

Keep accessible persistent freshness/error explanation, labelled comfortable controls and duplicate-retry busy feedback. Accessible announcements, contrast, focus and runtime reconnection need separate rendered verification.
Reuse existing provider/journal/retry/state/feedback equivalents. Offline/cache design cannot weaken server authorization, stage validation or payment integrity.
